summary: A cardholder makes a purchase during a billing cycle, receives a statement, and then pays the full statement balance on or before the due date. The balance stays within the credit limit and the issuer provides at least a 25-day grace window, so no late fee or over-limit fee is triggered.
assumptions: The account has no previous balance at the start of the billing cycle, so the grace-period condition in clause.6.grace_period is satisfied.
The credit limit is $1000.00, and the single purchase in this scenario does not cause the outstanding balance to exceed that limit.
The monthly statement closes on 2025-05-31 and shows a New Balance of $200.00 with a payment due date of 2025-06-25, giving at least 25 days before payment is due.
The cardholder pays the full $200.00 on the due date using an approved standard payment method, and the payment is credited on the date of receipt.
No cash advances, returned payments, disputed charges, international transactions, or extra fees occur in this scenario.

initialState.minimumPaymentFormula: greater of 3% of new balance or $15.00; if new balance is $15.00 or less, pay in full
